description: The AI services the Companion can ask for help on pages (0.71.0, docs/ai.md, A2). Data, checked by the host: a new service is a row. A service at a loopback address runs on this computer and needs no key and no Going online switch; any other must be https and needs a key. api: anthropic (Claude's own Messages API) or openai (the chat completions API most others offer). streamUsage: whether the service counts tokens in a stream when asked (stream_options).
